info.name: Smart Battery Calculator API v1.5 - Supabase Postgres + Storage
info.description: Full Postman verification collection for Smart Battery Calculator backend v1.3. Run folders in order. For requests containing a File field, select the relevant workbook manually after import. For the calculation and dedup requests, attach the exact same Vanikavipuldata.xls bytes. Admin credentials default to admin/123 for local development only; change collection variables for other environments.

variable.description: Backend base URL. Change to Render URL for deployed tests.
Local admin username. Change for production.
Set your real local/production admin password before running admin requests.
Generated by the user-account registration test.

item.name: 00 - System & Documentation
item.description: Basic server, DB/Octave readiness, and API documentation checks.

exec: pm.test("Correct API", function () { const b=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.name).to.eql("Smart Battery Calculator API"); pm.expect(b.api_version).to.eql("v1"); });

pm.test("Database, storage and Octave ready", function () { const b=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.status).to.eql("ready"); pm.expect(b.database.ready).to.eql(true); pm.expect(b.storage.ready).to.eql(true); pm.expect(b.engine.ready).to.eql(true); });
pm.test("Tariff response is an array", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.be.an("array"); });

request.description: Attach Vanikavipuldata.xls (or another valid two-column profile). This validates/stages the profile; it does not run the legacy battery calculation.

item.name: 02 - Calculation End-to-End
item.description: Run this folder in order. The first two requests require the same workbook file to be attached manually.

request.description: Attach Vanikavipuldata.xls. This stores the unique input and one canonical Results_RPAtrail400.csv.
Attach the exact same workbook bytes as the previous request. It should reuse both stored file IDs and skip Octave.

exec: pm.test("Private token is not echoed", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json()).to.not.have.property("access_token"); });

pm.test("Exactly input + CSV are available", function () { const b=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b).to.have.lengthOf(2); pm.expect(b.map(x=>x.kind).sort()).to.eql(["input_workbook","legacy_csv"].sort()); });
pm.test("Original input download returns 200", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test("Expected legacy filename is returned", function () { const cd=pm.response.headers.get("Content-Disposition") || ""; pm.expect(cd).to.include("Results_RPAtrail400.csv"); });
if (pm.response.code === 201) { const b=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.rating).to.eql(5); pm.collectionVariables.set("feedbackId", b.id); }

item.name: 03 - Optional User Accounts & Ownership
item.description: Register an optional user account, claim the retained guest calculation from section 02, then verify owner history.

exec: pm.test("Guest calculation is claimed", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test("Owned calculation list returns 200", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

pm.test("Claimed calculation is present", function () { const b=pm.response.json(); const rows=Array.isArray(b)?b:b.results; pm.expect(rows.some(x=>x.public_id===pm.collectionVariables.get("calculationPublicId"))).to.eql(true); });

item.name: Old Guest Token Is Rejected After Claim

exec: pm.test("Claimed record rejects guest token", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(403); });

item.name: Owner Can Retrieve Without Guest Token

exec: pm.test("Owner JWT retrieves calculation", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

item.name: 04 - Admin Authentication & Calculation Audit
item.description: Admin JWT, table/list/detail/filter/update/download and feedback audit checks.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 200) { const b=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.user.is_staff).to.eql(true); pm.collectionVariables.set("adminAccessToken", b.access); pm.collectionVariables.set("adminRefreshToken", b.refresh); }
if (pm.response.code === 200) { const b=pm.response.json(); pm.collectionVariables.set("adminAccessToken", b.access); if (b.refresh) pm.collectionVariables.set("adminRefreshToken", b.refresh); }
pm.test("Summary contains calculation counts", function () { const b=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.calculations).to.have.property("all_time"); });
pm.test("Admin calculation table returns 200", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

pm.test("Table rows expose flat admin columns", function () { const b=pm.response.json(); const rows=Array.isArray(b)?b:b.results; pm.expect(rows).to.be.an("array"); const row=rows.find(r=>r.public_id===pm.collectionVariables.get("calculationPublicId")); pm.expect(row).to.exist; pm.expect(row).to.have.property("postcode"); pm.expect(row).to.have.property("has_input_file"); pm.expect(row).to.have.property("has_csv_file"); });

pm.test("Returned rows match postcode", function () { const b=pm.response.json(); const rows=Array.isArray(b)?b:b.results; rows.forEach(r=>pm.expect(r.postcode).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("testPostcode"))); });
pm.test("Admin calculation detail returns 200", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test("Detail exposes two stored artifacts", function () { const b=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.files).to.be.an("array").that.has.lengthOf(2); });
pm.test("Admin metadata update succeeds", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test("Editable record fields changed", function () { const b=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.suburb).to.eql("Adelaide CBD"); pm.expect(b.metadata.verified).to.eql(true); });
pm.test("Admin input download succeeds", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test("Admin CSV download succeeds", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test("Admin feedback list returns 200", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

pm.test("Postman feedback is visible", function () { const b=pm.response.json(); const rows=Array.isArray(b)?b:b.results; const id=pm.collectionVariables.get("feedbackId"); pm.expect(rows.some(x=>x.id===id)).to.eql(true); });

item.name: Public Tariff List Contains Test Tariff

exec: pm.test("Public tariff list returns 200", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test("New active tariff is public", function () { const rows=pm.response.json(); const id=pm.collectionVariables.get("adminTariffId"); pm.expect(rows.some(x=>x.id===id)).to.eql(true); });
pm.test("Admin tariff detail returns 200", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test("Admin tariff list returns 200", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

pm.test("Admin tariff list contains test tariff", function () { const b=pm.response.json(); const rows=Array.isArray(b)?b:b.results; const id=pm.collectionVariables.get("adminTariffId"); pm.expect(rows.some(x=>x.id===id)).to.eql(true); });

item.name: 06 - Optional GNU Octave Diagnostics
item.description: Safe in both development and production: tests accept 404 when diagnostics are intentionally disabled.

request.description: Production normally returns 404 because OCTAVE_DIAGNOSTICS_ENABLED=False; development should return 200.

exec: pm.test("Diagnostics are enabled or intentionally disabled", function () { pm.expect([200,404]).to.include(pm.response.code); });
pm.test("Direct diagnostic succeeds or is disabled", function () { pm.expect([200,404]).to.include(pm.response.code); });

request.description: Attach Vanikavipuldata.xls when diagnostics are enabled. Production normally returns 404.

exec: pm.test("Workbook diagnostic succeeds or is disabled", function () { pm.expect([200,404]).to.include(pm.response.code); });

formdata.description: Attach Vanikavipuldata.xls. This validation request must not persist it.

item.name: 99 - DESTRUCTIVE Cleanup Checks
item.description: Run only after all normal verification. These requests deliberately delete stored input/CSV bytes, then verify both admin and guest calculation-record deletion, and remove the temporary Postman tariff.

request.description: DESTRUCTIVE: globally deletes the unique input bytes but keeps all calculation records and the CSV.

exec: pm.test("Input file deletion succeeds", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

item.name: Verify Input Deleted but CSV/Record Remain

exec: pm.test("Calculation record still exists", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test("Only CSV remains", function () { const b=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.files.map(x=>x.kind)).to.eql(["legacy_csv"]); });

request.description: DESTRUCTIVE: globally deletes Results_RPAtrail400.csv but retains calculation audit records.

item.name: Verify Files Deleted but Record Remains

exec: pm.test("Calculation record still exists", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
pm.test("No stored file bytes remain", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().files).to.have.lengthOf(0); });
pm.test("Primary calculation record deleted", function () { pm.response.to.have.status(204); });
